hero.description: Conversation Processing Demo follows one concrete workflow from authorized audio to transcript evidence, structured client and service-request proposals, human review, and an explicitly confirmed write.
hero.footnote: Designed to demonstrate the pattern safely—not to imply autonomous decisions, silent writes, or a production integration that is not there.

preview.lineA: The air conditioner in the front office stopped cooling yesterday.
preview.lineB: Tuesday afternoon works. You can reach me by email.

workflow.title: From spoken context to governed action.
workflow.description: The demo makes every transformation visible. Original evidence stays distinct from AI-derived structure, and the person reviewing it remains the authority.

capture.title: Capture
capture.description: Record in the browser or upload an authorized prepared audio file.

transcribe.title: Preserve
transcribe.description: Keep the original transcript and separate, fallible speaker segments.

structure.title: Propose
structure.description: Extract one client candidate and one or more service-request drafts.

review.title: Review
review.description: Correct gaps, ambiguity, duplicates, and evidence before readiness.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: Preview the exact record plan and approve one atomic creation.

capabilities.title: A narrow workflow with serious product boundaries.
capabilities.description: Built for conversations that need to become useful operational data without hiding uncertainty or handing authority to a model.

evidence.title: Evidence before automation
evidence.description: Proposed fields point back to transcript evidence. Original and derived artifacts remain visibly different, so confidence never replaces verification.

requests.title: One conversation, multiple needs
requests.description: A single reviewed conversation can prepare one client and several independent service requests, then create the complete set atomically.

assistant.title: The same rules for the assistant
assistant.description: A workspace-scoped AI assistant can retrieve context and prepare a plan, but it uses the same validation, approval, and write path as the direct UI.

safeguards.eyebrow: Trust is part of the demo
safeguards.title: AI proposes. Application code decides.
safeguards.description: The target baseline is designed around controlled access, inspectable evidence, bounded providers, and an exact approval step—not a magic black box.

workspace.title: Workspace isolation
workspace.description: The authenticated server context owns scope; browser or model input cannot choose another workspace.

approval.title: Operation-bound approval
approval.description: Every create shows the exact current plan. Stale, expired, or replayed approvals cannot create another batch.

provenance.title: Preserved provenance
provenance.description: Original transcript, speaker segmentation, corrections, and saved records keep their roles and history distinct.

portable.title: Provider-neutral contracts
portable.description: Speech and model providers sit behind application-owned capabilities so the demonstrated pattern is reusable.

demo.title: A concrete reference for your own conversation workflow.
demo.description: Use the demo to explore what a similar solution could look like for intake, field service, support, or any process where spoken context must become reviewed structured work.
demo.disclosure: This repository is being implemented in documented phases. Screens marked as demo use representative data and must not be read as production capability claims.

footer.description: A bilingual portfolio demonstration of evidence-first conversation processing and human-confirmed record creation.
